explanation: Searched for bijectivity/eq_bot characterizations of quotient maps: grepped `mk_bijective_iff_eq_bot`, `Bijective.*mk`, `bijective_iff_ker`, `ker_eq_bot.*bijective`, `Bijective.*Ideal.Quotient.mk`, `Bijective.*mkQ`/`mkQ.*Bijective`, and read the surrounding Ideal quotient files (`Quotient/Operations.lean`, `Quotient/Defs.lean`, `Quotient/Basic.lean`, `Ideal/Maps.lean`). The only bijectivity-vs-ker results are the general `RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot` (Ideal/Maps.lean:813) and `RingHom.Congruence.lift_bijective_iff` (Congruence/Hom.lean:215), neither of which states this result: deriving it needs combining `RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot`, `Ideal.mk_ker` and `Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective` (several declarations plus splitting the `Bijective` conjunction), so there is no single declaration giving this as a special case. No duplicate was found.
